source_mapping_rationale: AgriFreshNET 'Fresh' maps to 'Fresh' (peak post-harvest quality). AgriFreshNET 'Semi-Fresh' maps to 'Slightly Spoiled' (early softening, surface spotting, or initial oxidation). AgriFreshNET 'Rotten' maps to 'Rotten' (microbial decay, structural decomposition, extensive mold).
